environment.description: Service runs on ECS Fargate tasks in private subnets (no IGW, no NAT for inbound). Exposed exclusively through a VPC Endpoint Service (AWS PrivateLink) backed by a Network Load Balancer with internal scheme. The NLB target group health check path is /health. Consumer accounts connect via interface VPC endpoints (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). No public DNS resolution exists for the service. The VPC endpoint service has 'Acceptance Required' enabled, meaning each consumer VPC endpoint connection must be manually approved. Additionally, the endpoint service has an associated resource policy restricting principal access to specific AWS account IDs (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:root, arn:aws:iam::444455556666:root). The private subnet route tables have no route to any internet gateway or NAT gateway.

config.network: private subnets only, no IGW, no NAT gateway in route table
config.compute: ECS Fargate, awsvpc networking mode, private subnet task placement
config.security_group_task: inbound from NLB CIDR only on port 8080
config.log_pipeline: FireLens sidecar -> CloudWatch Logs structured JSON format
